# AiModeToggle

```ts
import { AiModeToggle } from '@cake-admin/cakeand';
```

A 32px toggle icon button that switches an input mode on or off inside the AI query input — voice input by default. It replaces the earlier radio. Use it for a mode the user turns on and leaves on; for a one-shot action (attach, send) use IconButton instead.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` | `'Voice input'` | Accessible name for the mode (required — the toggle shows only a glyph), e.g. "Voice input". Screen readers announce it with the pressed state. |
| `icon` | `React.ReactElement` | — | The mode glyph. Defaults to a microphone (voice input); swap it for another mode. Rendered in a 24px slot and colored via currentColor. The default microphone fills its capsule when pressed (the Figma filled-icon On state); a custom icon is shown as-is unless you pass pressedIcon. |
| `pressedIcon` | `React.ReactElement` | — | Glyph shown while pressed — the filled version of icon (Figma On state). Use it with a custom icon; the default microphone already has its own filled state. |
| `segment` | `AiSegment` | `'consumer'` | AI segment (Figma "Segment") — sets the pressed surface fill and accent. |
| `pressed` | `boolean` | — | Controlled pressed state (Figma State=On). Pair with onPressedChange. |
| `defaultPressed` | `boolean` | `false` | Uncontrolled initial pressed state. |
| `onPressedChange` | `(pressed: boolean) => void` | — | Called with the next pressed state. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Mode unavailable (Figma State=Disabled). |

Also accepts all `Omit<React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof RadixToggle.Root>, 'children' | 'asChild'>` props.

## Usage

```tsx
<AiModeToggle />
<AiModeToggle defaultPressed />
<AiModeToggle segment="commercial" pressed={voice} onPressedChange={setVoice} />
<AiModeToggle label="Web search" icon={<Globe />} />
<AiModeToggle disabled />
```

## Design tokens used

`--color-secondary-secondary`, `--color-secondary-secondary-overlay`, `--color-secondary-secondary-overlay-hover`, `--color-ai-`, `--color-disabled-disabled-inverse`, `--stroke-300`, `--color-primary-primary`, `--radius-1000`

## Accessibility

- Radix provides aria-pressed, Space/Enter toggling, and disabled semantics.
- The control is icon-only, so label (default "Voice input") is required context — it renders as visually hidden text via Radix AccessibleIcon. Name the mode, not the state ("Voice input", not "Turn on voice").
- Pressed state isn't conveyed by color alone: the surface changes and the default glyph fills. For a custom icon, pass a filled pressedIcon to keep that second cue.
- Focus is restyled (3px primary ring), never removed.

## Do / Don't

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Use for persistent modes (voice, web search) | Use for one-shot actions — that's IconButton |
| Match segment to the surrounding query input | Mix segments inside one input |
| Give each mode a clear label | Rely on the glyph alone to explain the mode |
| Disable when the mode is unavailable on the device | Hide it and shift the toolbar layout |
